### LOEWS CORPORATION ANNOUNCES QUARTERLY DIVIDEND ON COMMON STOCK


05/12/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/873173963/files/doc_news/LOEWS-CORPORATION-ANNOUNCES-QUARTERLY-DIVIDEND-ON-COMMON-STOCK-7ee2a1be5-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK


, May 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Loews Corporation (NYSE: L) announced today the declaration of the Company's quarterly dividend of $0.0625 per share of Common Stock, payable June 9, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 27, 2026.


Loews Corporation is a diversified company with businesses in the insurance, energy, hospitality, and packaging industries. For more information please visit[www.loews.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4686591-1&h=3071099344&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.loews.com%2F&a=www.loews.com) .
